title: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea
plot_overview: Through previously unseen footage and survivor accounts, this documentary examines a 2012 luxury cruise shipwreck and the disaster that followed. It traces the unfolding emergency and the experiences of people caught up in the incident.
will_you_like_this: You’ll like this if you’re drawn to documentaries built around survivor accounts and real maritime disasters; Not for you if you prefer lighter viewing or want to avoid intense accounts of tragedy.
review_summary: Pros: survivor accounts; unseen footage; immersive approach | Cons: distressing disaster subject; tragic events; intense viewing
